mechanism.grading_law: keyword auto-grade: case-insensitive whole-token match of the learner text against keywords[]; >=1 hit -> correct verdict (same emerald Correct path + explanation/model answer); 0 hits -> Not quite + model answer; empty submit -> blocked (mirror of continueDisabledUntilChoice spirit); keywords absent -> reveal-only (model answer shown, no verdict) — fail-closed, never a silent wrong grade
mechanism.renderer_law: both sites in lockstep: MCQ path untouched; written kinds render a labelled input/textarea, submit -> verdict role=status + model answer; a11y: label for the input, aria-live on verdict; the flow stage feeds keyword-hit boolean into the existing onAnswer tally without changing its signature semantics (correct: boolean)
mechanism.fail_closed: written-kind item missing modelAnswer -> renders stem + reveal-only, never gradeable, never blank; unknown kind value -> renders as reveal-only and counts as a designed warning at the export gate, never guessed
